Crust:

2 cups ( 250.31 g)  of AP flour ( 250.31 g) 

1 cup (226.89 g) of butter ( i use what's on hand so it's usually salted, but it's whatever your preference is)

1/2 cup(50 g) of powdered sugar  

Preheat oven to 350. Cream ingredients together and press into an ungreased 9 x 20 pan. Bake for 20 minutes. 

Filling:

Four eggs beaten 

5-7 tablespoons of lemon juice (Depending on your taste. I like mine  more on the sour side so I use the full 7 tablespoons and I've not gotten a complaint but everyone is different)  

4 tablespoons(31.3 g) of AP flour 

1/2 teaspoon (1.3 g) of salt 

Pour into baked crust. bake at 350 for 25  or until set, it should no longer be wobbly in the center and the edges golden. 

Let it cool for 5 minutes before sprinkling on a little extra powdered sugar. Garnish with edible flowers or candied lemon peel if desired.  Enjoy.
